titles.title: LIFT AI Act
LIFT AI Act
Literacy in Future Technologies Artificial Intelligence Act
To improve educational efforts related to artificial intelligence literacy at the K through 12 level, and for other purposes.

action.text: Referred to the House Committee on Science, Space, and Technology.
Committee Consideration and Mark-up Session Held
Ordered to be Reported (Amended) by the Yeas and Nays: 34 - 1.

bill.summary:
Literacy in Future Technologies Artificial Intelligence Act or the LIFT AI Act
This bill authorizes the National Science Foundation to make merit-based grants to institutions of higher education, nonprofit organizations, and consortia of such entities to support artificial intelligence (AI) literacy for K-12 students and educators. Grants may be used for research and development of educational curricula, instructional material, professional development for teachers, and evaluation methods for AI literacy at the K-12 level.
